name: Build Your PM Portfolio
title: Build a PM portfolio that makes hiring managers take you seriously.
lede: A hands-on program where we build a standout product portfolio together — the right case studies, the narrative that ties them, and a polished site that proves you can think like a PM. High-touch, done with you, not handed to you.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if the first session isn't worth it, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Applying to PM roles with nothing to show beyond a resume
Switching into product and needing proof you can do the work
Sitting on projects but unable to package them as case studies
Told your application is 'thin' and not sure how to fix it
Willing to put in real work — this is a build, not a template
notForYou: You want a portfolio written entirely for you overnight
You're not ready to invest a few weeks of focused effort
You only need a quick resume tune-up (start smaller)
howItWorksTitle: We build it together, step by step

howItWorks.d: Checkout securely, then book your 90-minute kickoff. We map your target roles and choose the case studies that will land.
We shape each case study — problem, decisions, trade-offs, outcome — into the narrative hiring managers actually look for.
We assemble it into a clean, polished portfolio site and tighten the story end to end.
Between sessions you send drafts and I give specific feedback so momentum never stalls.

deliverables: Two to three strong, well-structured PM case studies
A narrative that connects your work to the roles you want
A repeatable structure for writing future case studies
Direct, specific feedback at every step
A resume and LinkedIn that point to your portfolio

faq.q: How many sessions is this, and over how long?
faq.a: It's a program built around a 90-minute kickoff plus working sessions and async feedback, typically spread across a few weeks depending on your pace and how many case studies we build.

faq.q: What if I don't have 'real' PM projects yet?
faq.a: That's common, and fine. We can build credible case studies from side projects, work you've shipped in another role, or a structured product proposal — the same way strong candidates do it.

faq.q: Do you build the site for me?
faq.a: We build it together. You come out able to maintain and extend it yourself, which matters more than a site you can't touch.

faq.q: Is the price per session or for everything?
faq.a: It's a single program price covering the kickoff, working sessions, and async feedback through to a shipped portfolio.

faq.q: Can we focus on AI PM roles specifically?
faq.a: Absolutely. We'll pick case studies and framing that position you for AI product roles if that's your target.

finalCta.title: Build the portfolio that gets you the interview.
finalCta.sub: Start today and walk away with a live site and case studies you're proud to send.
